mapper.sql: CASE WHEN ISNULL(${a}DC_CD,'') <> '' THEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(${a}DC_CD))) WHEN ISNULL(${a}DC_NM,'') LIKE N'%용인%' THEN 'E100' WHEN ISNULL(${a}DC_NM,'') LIKE N'%왜관%' THEN 'E200' WHEN ISNULL(${a}DC_NM,'') LIKE N'%김해%' THEN 'E300' WHEN ISNULL(${a}DC_NM,'') LIKE N'%광주%' THEN 'E400' WHEN ISNULL(${a}DC_NM,'') LIKE N'%평택%' THEN 'E500' WHEN ISNULL(${a}DC_NM,'') LIKE N'%제주%' THEN 'E600' WHEN ISNULL(${a}DC_NM,'') LIKE N'%오산%' THEN 'E700' ELSE '' END
mapper.select: SELECT v.VENDOR_CD AS custCd, MAX(ISNULL(v.VENDOR_NM,'')) AS custNm, MAX(ISNULL(v.FULL_NM,'')) AS fullNm, MAX(ISNULL(v.BIZNO,'')) AS bizno, MAX(ISNULL(v.CEO_NM,'')) AS ceoNm, MAX(ISNULL(v.BIZ_COND,'')) AS bizCond, MAX(ISNULL(v.BIZ_ITEM,'')) AS bizItem, MAX(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(v.ADDR,'') + ' ' + ISNULL(v.ADDR2,'')))) AS addr, MAX(ISNULL(v.EMAIL,'')) AS email, MAX(ISNULL(v.VENDOR_GB,'')) AS vendorGb, MAX(ISNULL(v.MGR_CD,'')) AS mgrCd, MAX(ISNULL(v.MGR_NM,'')) AS mgrNm, MAX(ISNULL(v.VAT_GB,'')) AS vatGb, MAX(ISNULL(v.TAXBILL_GB,'')) AS taxbillGb FROM TBL_VENDOR_MST v WHERE v.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND v.COMP_CD = #{compCd} GROUP BY v.VENDOR_CD

SELECT m.BILL_SEQ AS billSeq, m.CUST_CD AS custCd, m.MAKE_GB AS makeGb, m.BASIS_GB AS basisGb, m.TAX_GB AS taxGb, ISNULL(m.SRC_KEY,'') AS srcKey, m.FR_DT AS frDt, m.TO_DT AS toDt, m.WRITE_DT AS writeDt, m.STATUS AS status, m.TOT_AMT AS totAmt FROM TBL_TAXBILL_MST m WHERE m.COMP_CD = #{compCd} AND m.BILL_GB = #{billGb} AND m.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ISNULL(m.FR_DT, m.WRITE_DT) <= #{toDt} AND ISNULL(m.TO_DT, m.WRITE_DT) >= #{frDt} ORDER BY m.BILL_SEQ
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_TAXBILL_MST (COMP_CD, BILL_GB, MAKE_GB, BASIS_GB, TAX_GB, PURPOSE_GB, WRITE_DT, FR_DT, TO_DT, SRC_KEY, CUST_CD, CUST_NM, CUST_FULL_NM, CUST_BIZNO, CUST_CEO_NM, CUST_BIZ_COND, CUST_BIZ_ITEM, CUST_ADDR, CUST_EMAIL, SUPPLY_AMT, VAT_AMT, TOT_AMT, REMARK, STATUS, ACTION_YN, REG_USER, REG_DTTM) SELECT TOP 1 #{compCd}, #{billGb}, #{makeGb}, #{basisGb}, #{taxGb,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{purposeGb,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{writeDt}, #{frDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{toDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{srcKey,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, v.VENDOR_CD, ISNULL(v.VENDOR_NM,''), ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(v.FULL_NM)),''), ISNULL(v.VENDOR_NM,'')), REPLACE(REPLACE(ISNULL(v.BIZNO,''),'-',''),' ',''), ISNULL(v.CEO_NM,''), ISNULL(v.BIZ_COND,''), ISNULL(v.BIZ_ITEM,''), LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(v.ADDR,'') + ' ' + ISNULL(v.ADDR2,''))), ISNULL(v.EMAIL,''), #{supplyAmt}, #{vatAmt}, #{totAmt}, #{remark,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, 'W', 'Y', #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, GETDATE() FROM TBL_VENDOR_MST v WHERE v.COMP_CD = #{compCd} AND v.VENDOR_CD = #{custCd} AND v.ACTION_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY CASE WHEN ISNULL(v.BIZNO,'') <> '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END

INSERT INTO TBL_TAXBILL_DTL (BILL_SEQ, LINE_NO, ITEM_DT, ITEM_CD, ITEM_NM, SPEC, QTY, PRICE, SUPPLY_AMT, VAT_AMT, REMARK) VALUES
(#{billSeq}, #{l.lineNo}, #{l.itemDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{l.itemCd,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{l.itemNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{l.spec,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{l.qty,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{l.price,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{l.supplyAmt}, #{l.vatAmt}, #{l.remark,jdbcType=NVARCHAR})
mapper.select:
SELECT m.BILL_SEQ AS billSeq, m.BILL_GB AS billGb, m.MAKE_GB AS makeGb, m.BASIS_GB AS basisGb, m.TAX_GB AS taxGb, m.PURPOSE_GB AS purposeGb, m.WRITE_DT AS writeDt, m.FR_DT AS frDt, m.TO_DT AS toDt, m.CUST_CD AS custCd, m.CUST_NM AS custNm, m.CUST_FULL_NM AS fullNm, m.CUST_BIZNO AS bizno, m.CUST_CEO_NM AS ceoNm, m.CUST_EMAIL AS email, m.SUPPLY_AMT AS supplyAmt, m.VAT_AMT AS vatAmt, m.TOT_AMT AS totAmt, ISNULL(m.REMARK,'') AS remark, m.STATUS AS status, m.ACTION_YN AS actionYn, ISNULL(m.NTS_NO,'') AS ntsNo, CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), m.REG_DTTM, 120) AS regDttm, ISNULL(m.REG_USER,'') AS regUser, CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), m.CFM_DTTM, 120) AS cfmDttm, ISNULL(m.CFM_USER,'') AS cfmUser, CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), m.ISSUE_DTTM, 120) AS issueDttm, ISNULL(dl.cnt,0) AS lineCnt, ISNULL(dl.firstNm,'') AS firstNm FROM TBL_TAXBILL_MST m OUTER APPLY ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, (SELECT TOP 1 d2.ITEM_NM FROM TBL_TAXBILL_DTL d2 WHERE d2.BILL_SEQ = m.BILL_SEQ ORDER BY d2.LINE_NO) AS firstNm FROM TBL_TAXBILL_DTL d WHERE d.BILL_SEQ = m.BILL_SEQ ) dl WHERE m.COMP_CD = #{compCd} AND m.BILL_GB = #{billGb} AND m.WRITE_DT >= #{frDt} AND m.WRITE_DT <= #{toDt}
AND m.ACTION_YN = 'Y'
AND ( m.STATUS IN #{st} OR m.ACTION_YN = 'N' )
AND ( m.CUST_CD LIKE '%' + #{kw,jdbcType=NVARCHAR} + '%' OR m.CUST_NM LIKE '%' + #{kw,jdbcType=NVARCHAR} + '%' OR m.CUST_FULL_NM LIKE '%' + #{kw,jdbcType=NVARCHAR} + '%' OR m.CUST_BIZNO LIKE '%' + #{kw,jdbcType=NVARCHAR} + '%' )
ORDER BY m.WRITE_DT DESC, m.BILL_SEQ DESC

SELECT m.BILL_SEQ AS billSeq, m.BILL_GB AS billGb, m.MAKE_GB AS makeGb, m.BASIS_GB AS basisGb, m.TAX_GB AS taxGb, m.PURPOSE_GB AS purposeGb, m.WRITE_DT AS writeDt, m.FR_DT AS frDt, m.TO_DT AS toDt, m.SRC_KEY AS srcKey, m.CUST_CD AS custCd, m.CUST_NM AS custNm, m.CUST_FULL_NM AS fullNm, m.CUST_BIZNO AS bizno, m.CUST_CEO_NM AS ceoNm, m.CUST_BIZ_COND AS bizCond, m.CUST_BIZ_ITEM AS bizItem, m.CUST_ADDR AS addr, m.CUST_EMAIL AS email, m.SUPPLY_AMT AS supplyAmt, m.VAT_AMT AS vatAmt, m.TOT_AMT AS totAmt, ISNULL(m.REMARK,'') AS remark, m.STATUS AS status, m.ACTION_YN AS actionYn, ISNULL(m.NTS_NO,'') AS ntsNo FROM TBL_TAXBILL_MST m WHERE m.COMP_CD = #{compCd} AND m.BILL_SEQ = #{billSeq}

SELECT m.BILL_SEQ AS billSeq, m.CUST_NM AS custNm, ISNULL(m.CUST_BIZNO,'') AS bizno FROM TBL_TAXBILL_MST m WHERE m.COMP_CD = #{compCd} AND m.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND m.BILL_SEQ IN #{s} AND ( LEN(ISNULL(m.CUST_BIZNO,'')) <> 10 OR ISNULL(m.CUST_BIZNO,'') LIKE '%[^0-9]%' )
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_TAXBILL_MST SET STATUS = #{toSt}, CFM_DTTM = CASE WHEN #{toSt} = 'C' THEN GETDATE() ELSE NULL END, CFM_USER = CASE WHEN #{toSt} = 'C' THEN #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ELSE NULL END, UPD_USER = #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPD_DTTM = GETDATE() WHERE COMP_CD = #{compCd} AND ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND STATUS = #{fromSt} AND BILL_SEQ IN #{s}
UPDATE TBL_TAXBILL_MST SET ACTION_YN = 'N', UPD_USER = #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPD_DTTM = GETDATE() WHERE COMP_CD = #{compCd} AND ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND STATUS = 'W' AND BILL_SEQ IN #{s}

UPDATE TBL_TAXBILL_MST SET WRITE_DT = #{writeDt}, PURPOSE_GB = #{purposeGb,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, CUST_EMAIL = #{email,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, REMARK = #{remark,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, UPD_USER = #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPD_DTTM = GETDATE() WHERE COMP_CD = #{compCd} AND BILL_SEQ = #{billSeq} AND ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND STATUS = 'W'
mapper.select: SELECT TOP 1 ISNULL(c.COMP_NM,'') AS compNm, REPLACE(ISNULL(c.BUSI_NUM,''),'-','') AS bizno, ISNULL(c.COMP_CEO,'') AS ceoNm, LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(c.COMP_ADDR,'') + ' ' + ISNULL(c.COMP_EXTRADR,''))) AS addr, ISNULL(c.BIZ_COND,'') AS bizCond, ISNULL(c.BIZ_ITEM,'') AS bizItem, ISNULL(c.COMP_EMAIL,'') AS email, ISNULL(c.COMP_TEL,'') AS tel FROM TBL_COMP_MST c WHERE c.COMP_CD = #{compCd} AND ISNULL(c.ACTION_YN,'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY c.JOB_SEQ DESC
